children: In a market short on fresh triggers, several stocks quietly grabbed attention on September 1, driven by technical breakouts, strong price action, and sustained buying interest.
The selected stocks are showing strong upward momentum, trading well above their key short- to medium-term moving averages, which indicates a positive trend in the near term.

Radhika Jewel rose 6.15% to Rs 72.50 and traded above its 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day simple moving averages of Rs 68.30, Rs 64.69, Rs 63.24 and Rs 66.76, respectively, indicating a strong bullish technical setup. The stock is trading above all key moving averages, with the short-term averages also supporting the positive momentum

Maitreya Medica gained 5.66% to Rs 126.85. The stock remained above its 30-day moving average of Rs 120.05 but was below its 50-day, 150-day and 200-day moving averages of Rs 128.03, Rs 169.85 and Rs 189.42, respectively. This suggests that while the stock is showing short-term recovery, its medium- and long-term technical trend remains weak

Cyber Media Res climbed 3.60% to Rs 68.20 and traded above its 30-day and 50-day moving averages of Rs 65.83 and Rs 67.03. However, it remained below the 150-day and 200-day moving averages of Rs 71.69 and Rs 74.86, indicating improving short-term momentum but a still cautious medium- to long-term technical trend
The selected stocks are witnessing downward pressure, as reflected in negative price movements and their positioning relative to key moving averages, indicating a cautious market sentiment.

Happiest Minds declined 7.11% to Rs 373.60 and traded below its 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day moving averages of Rs 402.18, Rs 385.72, Rs 380.06 and Rs 404.56, respectively. The stock’s position below all key moving averages indicates weak short- and long-term technical momentum

Prestige Estate fell 3.93% to Rs 1,552.90. The stock remained below its 30-day and 50-day moving averages of Rs 1,616.45 and Rs 1,624.29, but traded above its 150-day and 200-day averages of Rs 1,466.35 and Rs 1,506.64. This indicates short-term weakness, while the medium- and long-term trend remains relatively stronger

Bikaji Foods declined 3.69% to Rs 601.60 and traded below its 30-day, 50-day, 150-day and 200-day moving averages of Rs 624.63, Rs 633.50, Rs 643.80 and Rs 662.89, respectively. Trading below all four key moving averages points to broad-based technical weakness and suggests that the stock remains under selling pressure across short-, medium- and long-term timeframes.

Meanwhile, several stocks touched fresh 52-week high, highlighting persistent buying. Notable names touching new one-year high included Engineers India, Sai Life Sciences, HEG, Ather Energy, Bajaj Auto, Welspun Living, Ipca Labs, Bosch, Aurobindo Pharma, Oracle Fin Services, Leela Palaces touched 52-week high.

On the other hand, Alok Industries, Inox Wind, Godrej Consumer, JK Lakshmi Cement, HDFC Bank, PI Industries, Swan Corp, HUL, Dabur India, Rail Vikas Nigam, IRFC, P&G Hygiene, Emami, UTI AMC, IRCTC, hit 52-week low.
Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri, Niraj Ispat Industries, Modison among others were locked in their upper circuits, reflecting strong buying and signalling bullish near-term sentiment.

title: Momentum Stocks: TBZ, Niraj Ispat, Modison locked at upper circuits; Happiest Minds declines 7%
